title: Purushottama Yoga
translation: The Yoga of the Supreme Person
summary: Krishna uses the symbol of an inverted Banyan tree to explain the material world and reveals Himself as the Supreme Person (Purushottama) who transcends both the perishable and imperishable.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् |
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् || १ ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: It is said that there is an imperishable banyan tree that has its roots upward and its branches down and whose leaves are the Vedic hymns. One who knows this tree is the knower of the Vedas.
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śākham aśvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam
chandāṁsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit
verses.meaning: Urdhva-mulam - with roots above; Adhah-shakham - branches below...
